title: Midterm Messaging 2026: corpus and labels
description: What about 300 candidates for the U.S. House, Senate and governor said on their own campaign channels in the 2026 midterms, August 1 to Election Day (November 3, 2026): 48,805 messages from X, Bluesky, YouTube and campaign websites, each labeled for topic, tone, targets and stance by Claude Sonnet 5 under a written codebook, with the codebook, 263 hand labels beside the model's, and a script that recomputes the published accuracy figures. Text is included for Bluesky, YouTube and websites; X posts are shared as IDs, with a script that fetches their text. The data behind the tracker at https://barbeau.dev/midterms-2026.
